about: What docs/javascripts/projects.js reads of the data of the dashboard of the blueprint at /repo-blueprint/dashboard/: the schema of repos.json that it knows, and the kind of every field that it reads of an entry of repos.json, of its health and of a day of history.json. The watch of the catalog bot, python3 -I .github/mkdocs_project.py --watch, checks the live data against it every day, whose KINDS describe each kind, and tests/projects.test.mjs checks that the script knows this schema and reads these fields and no other: change both with the script.
